settings.outputFolder.name: Output folder
settings.outputFolder.desc: Vault folder where generated notes are saved. Leave empty to use the vault root. Use {{currentFolder}} to start from the current note's folder and {{date:YYYY}} for the current date, for example: {{currentFolder}}/{{date:YYYY}}.
settings.fileNameColumn.name: File name column

settings.baseTag.desc: Tag used to find notes in the Base. Leave empty to use the current note name.
settings.allowEmptyColumns.name: Allow empty values
settings.allowEmptyColumns.desc: Allow empty property cells in the table.
